svg.text: stripboard, 24 × 32 mm, 9 × 12 holes, horizontal strips · standing under screen 2, z 139.9–171.9
CONNECTORS (HARNESS SIDE, PIN 1 ON THE LEFT; NO. = WIRE OF THIS BOARD)
X4 screen 2 · Dupont 1 × 8 on a right-angle header
X8 DS3231 · Dupont 1 × 6 on a right-angle header, 4 wires
in series, standing, straddles the C11 cut
16 V tantalum, + at F9 (3V3); or X5R / X7R ceramic ≥ 6.3 V
AM312 filter, 16 V tantalum (+ at F6); or 47 µF electrolytic Ø5 × 7 at most
in series, standing, straddles the C4 cut
WIRES (DRAWING NO. · HOLE · SIGNAL · WIRE · OTHER END: ● SOLDERED, D DUPONT, XH JST-XH, F / M · TO)
right tube → X8 DS3231 / X9 BME280 GND [X9 br. 2 + X8 br. 6]
right tube → X8 / X9 VCC [X9 br. 1 + X8 br. 5]
right tube → X9 / X8 SDA [X9 br. 4 + X8 br. 4]
right tube → X9 / X8 SCL [X9 br. 3 + X8 br. 3]
left and right edges: lid tabs and stops (≈ 1.5 mm)
Cuts at C11 and C4 (3 mm drill turned by hand on the copper side): R10 and R17 are in series in their strip.
Insulated jumper I10 → I5 on the copper side (the lid tabs only touch rows 1 and 12): strips 10 and 5 are both
GND (C12 needs a GND next to PIR_VDD).
The S3 wire arrives before the series resistor (A11 AMP_SD_S3, A4 PIR), the module one after it (F11 AMP_SD, F4
PIR_OUT): don't swap them, otherwise R10 / R17 are shorted.
Part height ≤ 9 mm on the component side (10.4 mm up to the front wall); columns A and I: wires bent inwards
right out of the hole (front stops).
The SPI, CS2, BL_EN and I2S wires of screen 2 / the amplifier don't go through P2: tube → connector directly.
